IIT Jammu English Instructor Recruitment 2026 - Selection Process
Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to attend the walk-in interview for the English Instructor post at IIT Jammu?
faq.answer: The last date to attend the walk-in interview for the English Instructor post at IIT Jammu is 13 August 2026. Candidates are advised to reach the venue on time with all necessary documents.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the English Instructor position?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Master's degree in English Language Teaching, Communicative English, or English with at least 60% marks. Relevant teaching experience and certifications are also desirable.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for the English Instructor role?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the English Instructor position is 35 years. There are no specific minimum age requirements mentioned in the provided data.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the English Instructor post?
faq.answer: The selected candidate for the English Instructor post will receive a monthly salary ranging from Rs. 55,000 to Rs. 70,000.

faq.question: Q5. How can I apply for the English Instructor position at IIT Jammu?
faq.answer: The application process is through a Walk-in Interview. Candidates need to report to the specified venue on the walk-in date with all required documents.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for the English Instructor recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q7. What documents should I carry for the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: Candidates should carry all original documents, self-attested photocopies, and recent passport-size photographs. This includes ID proof, educational certificates, and experience certificates.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for the English Instructor role?
faq.answer: The selection process involves a Walk-in Interaction-based evaluation/interview followed by Document Verification.

faq.question: Q9. What is the job type for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The job type for the English Instructor position at IIT Jammu is on a Contract basis.

faq.question: Q10. Where is IIT Jammu located?
faq.answer: IIT Jammu is located in Jammu, Jammu and Kashmir. The specific address for the walk-in interview will be detailed in the official notification.
